outputs.prompt:
Create a realistic, production-quality UI design concept for the existing Chinese single-player 2D action game 关公·过五关斩六将, focusing only on the first level 东岭关. Use the attached current gameplay screenshot as the EDIT TARGET, not merely inspiration. Target a single 1920×1080 16:9 game viewport (the source is 960×540); no browser chrome, device frame, explanatory sidebars, collage, comparison grid or external title. Preserve the detailed autumn stone gate background, warm sunset light, flags, trees, camera framing and ground plane. Preserve the distinct pixel-art Guan Yu in green on the left and Kong Xiu with spear on the right, their identities, relative scale, locations and crisp pixel treatment. Do not turn the sprites into realistic painted characters. Change the HUD overlays, not the art direction of the game. Reconstruct any small scenery portions exposed when removing old UI. Remove the obsolete rectangular health/objective panels, large tutorial/message banner, bottom text strip and gray bottom edge. New UI must feel like a coherent professional wuxia action game: deep ink green #0D1B17, warm paper #EEE2C3, old gold #C7A15A, jade #72B69A and cinnabar #A74632; modest material texture, very restrained ornament, clean hierarchy, plenty of visible battlefield. Exactly two type styles: pointed Chinese Kai calligraphy for names, readable Song/serif for labels and keycaps. Chinese text must be legible and accurate. No extra gameplay systems: no minimap, inventory, quests list, XP, stamina, coins, new abilities or touchscreen controls. Keep three small quiet utility controls at top right labeled 操作, 声音, 暂停. Mock state in all concepts: Guan Yu health 4 of 6; 义气 4 of 4 ready; Kong Xiu health half. A single small L keycap may label 偃月斩 ready. Never fill the image with descriptions or legends. This is an aspirational interface concept, not a captured implementation.
Direction name: 六段玉色气血. Design the restrained readable version. Keep all essential status in the upper region. Upper left: a compact player cluster with small existing-pixel-art Guan Yu portrait crop, calligraphic 关羽 and a slender old-gold outlined health trough divided into EXACTLY SIX equally sized, connected jade sections: four jade sections filled, final two empty dark green. Make each section instantly countable, without health numbers or duplicated caption. Small jade-carved end caps, not a dragon-head sculpture. Immediately below, EXACTLY FOUR small old-gold jade beads all lit, a quiet 义气 label and L 偃月斩 ready marker. Main player cluster occupies about 290×78 source pixels. Top center with clear separation from player cluster: readable 孔秀 · 东岭守将 over a 380-source-pixel cinnabar boss bar, half full, thin ornamental spear-tip ends. No duplicate 东岭关 headline or defeat-boss objective. Show a modest, thin, outlined wedge on the ground pointing forward from Kong Xiu for 横扫 attack telegraph, with the small accurate text 横扫 near his spear; avoid opaque red rectangle. Keep the two characters in the source windup poses. This version should communicate survival and readiness at a glance and remain exceptionally quiet. Do not draw visual concept name inside image.

Direction name: 朱红笔触气血. Design a distinctly brush-painted, cinematic alternative with a continuous life bar and a bottom boss bar. Match the reference scene and the same calm windup moment; do not add active hit effects. Upper left: an exceptionally elegant open composition, NO big enclosing rectangular card. A small dark jade carved medallion bearing 关, with readable 关羽 to its right, and below it a continuous slender CINNABAR RED player health brush stroke at TWO THIRDS full, its missing last third visible as an ink trough. Not segmented, no six bead health, no hearts. The bar has natural dry-brush ends and an extremely thin aged-gold upper rule. A very soft local ink wash provides contrast without a box. Immediately below it arrange four tiny diamond-shaped old-gold 义气 markers ALL FOUR filled, plus compact L 偃月斩 text. Upper center: a small calligraphic 东岭关 title, subtle and spacious. At BOTTOM CENTER just above viewport edge and below the characters' feet, put 孔秀 · 东岭守将 above a long very slender old-gold/ivory boss health stroke, HALF FULL with dark missing half. Differentiate boss life from player red life by placement, light color, name and spear-tip endpoints. Keep the bottom boss UI within about 58 source pixels of height, not a large panel. Use the same small top-right utility controls. Enemy sweep tell is a restrained amber curved arc on the ground with two fine boundary lines and small 横扫 text near the opponent. Leave the middle two thirds of the image almost entirely scenery and characters, with no mission banner. The result should be noticeably lighter and more literary than the jade segmented version, with purposeful asymmetry, paper-colored calligraphy and mature Chinese ink-painting UI, while preserving the existing pixel game. No concept name rendered inside image.

Direction name: 完整战斗反馈. A third independent composition showing the complete proposed combat feedback system at a successful PARRY instant. Use the same Dongling gate environment, same game scale and same Guan Yu and Kong Xiu identity and screen positions, but allow small coherent pose adjustments: Guan Yu's crescent blade intercepts Kong Xiu's spear between the two characters; show a concentrated old-gold metallic spark burst at the ACTUAL weapon contact, a tiny bright impact core and only several short particles. Put a small energetic calligraphic 破 near the impact, never huge and never covering a face. No explosion, no magic dragon, no fullscreen glow, no blur over the characters. Enemy spear recoils slightly. This is a perfect parry, so remove the active ground danger zone; a faint dying arc may remain. Demonstrate a small arc-like jade afterimage at Guan Yu's weapon, NOT a full heavy-attack giant slash and NOT simultaneous two different moves.
Layout is DISTINCT: upper-left only a small quiet 东岭关 chapter title in warm paper calligraphy with one fine gold rule; upper-center prominent but airy 孔秀 · 东岭守将, with small secondary 奋战, above a half-full cinnabar boss health bar around 400 source pixels wide, no enclosing black box. Keep top-right 操作 声音 暂停 controls small. Player status cluster moves to LOWER LEFT, safely below characters and above bottom edge, about 285×76 source pixels with a soft localized ink-green wash, not a huge panel. It includes a small pixel portrait of Guan Yu, 关羽, exactly SIX individually countable jade health segments (four filled, two empty), a small pale trailing damage highlight within the empty portion to suggest responsive recent damage; immediately underneath exactly FOUR GOLD DIAMOND 义气 markers fully lit, with subtle L 偃月斩 ready. A small SPACE keycap and a very slim partial ring nearby communicate the EXISTING dodge cooldown, not a new stamina resource. Keep Chinese labels short and accurate. Main status visually stable, no numbers, combo meters, banners or redundant objectives. The visual hierarchy should clearly be the two fighting characters and parry spark first, boss health second, player survival/readiness third. Keep center battlefield open. Restrained jade, old gold and paper-colored interface materials match current game's wuxia language. Avoid ornate HUD sculptures and massive shields. Do not render concept direction name or concept labeling inside image.

limitations: Generated typography, sprites, scenery and aspect ratio are interpretive. Final font, exact six health / four resource geometry, contrast and input behavior require Godot implementation and verification. No runtime assets replaced.
